content.short: Mountain Protocol is the issuer of USDM, a regulated and yield-bearing stablecoin backed by short-term US Treasuries.
content.description: Mountain Protocol is a pioneering decentralized finance project and the issuer of USDM, the industry's first regulated and permissionless yield-bearing stablecoin. Fully backed by high-quality, short-term US Treasuries, USDM is designed to provide holders with a secure and stable asset that earns a daily rebase yield. This allows users to receive returns similar to those of traditional money market funds directly in their digital wallets, making it an efficient tool for both institutional and retail participants. Operating across major networks including Ethereum, Base, and Arbitrum, Mountain Protocol provides a robust framework for tokenized real-world assets (RWAs).
